title: Writer Assistant Core tool evaluation and extraction strategy decision
goal: Prepare a controlled evaluation phase for deciding how nine approved tools/references should or should not be used for future Writer Assistant Core extraction, producing an evaluation plan, scoring rubric, source inventory plan, and extraction strategy decision without runtime extraction behavior.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-001 through PHASE8-IMPL-004 completed candidate schema, validation, persistence, and derived index infrastructure. Extraction implementation must not begin until tool strategy is decided for the nine approved candidates.

include: Narrowed nine-tool/reference inventory for evaluation only.
Next parent handoff for first extraction architecture/implementation.
exclude: Tool installs, clones, demos, or executions in T001.
Extraction adapters and candidate extraction runtime.
Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, or prose improvement.
Semantic search and Story Check auto-runs.
Apply-promotion, OMI candidate promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset artifacts, and project runtime files.
CoreNLP/OpenIE/SUTime, AI-Reader-V2, narrative-blueprint, NovelClaw, NotebookLM workflow, llm_finetuning, ai-llm-project-file-structure-template unless later owner-approved parent reintroduces them.

quality_notes: T001 publishes the parent and child plan only.
PHASE8-IMPL-004 completed derived candidate index contract/helpers; extraction deferred to evaluation-first parent.
Scope narrowed to exactly nine approved tools/references.
T003 is the first child allowed to retrieve official source information.
T002 accepted evaluation scope, fixture category plan, scoring rubric, and T003 inventory requirements.
T003 completed official source inventory and license/dependency screen from official docs/repos only.
T004 accepted dramatica-flow as reference-only; runtime adapter REJECT/DEFER; no install/clone/execution.

T005 accepted NCP as reference-only/future approved-context import-export candidate and Subtxt docs as reference-only/future semantic rubric candidate; runtime adapter/import/export/Subtxt analysis REJECT/DEFER.

T006 accepted spaCy-first local deterministic/rule-assisted candidate extraction foundation as the first extraction strategy; segram, BookNLP, GLiNER, LangExtract, and Renard are deferred from the first implementation slice.
No runtime extraction implementation, tool evaluation execution, installs, fixtures, or runtime code in T002-T006.

PHASE8-IMPL-005-T001 publishes the parent, inventory, enrichment JSON, and roadmap/status updates.
Scope is narrowed to exactly nine approved tools/references.
Official source retrieval policy records T003 as first allowed retrieval child.
Child tasks T001-T007 are documented with evaluation-first sequencing.
Non-scope blocks extraction implementation, routes, UI, model calls, tool execution in T001, apply-promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
External tools remain replaceable adapters around app-owned Writer Assistant Core.
Tool output must become candidates with evidence/provenance, never canon.

safety_notes: No generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Tool output does not prove story truth.
External tools must become candidate records with evidence/provenance if ever implemented.
Owner approval remains mandatory before durable truth.
OMI remains the central review and future promotion layer.
Promotion records remain audit-only until future apply-promotion exists.
Memory/canon mutation is out of scope.
dramatica-flow, NCP, and Subtxt docs are evaluation/reference sources, not runtime dependencies or automatic truth.
deferred_work: First extraction architecture/implementation parent until T007 closeout.
context_tools_policy: T001 does not run context tools.
Context tools may only be used in a later child if the child explicitly authorizes narrow collection.
Context output is evidence, not roadmap truth.
Roadmap truth remains roadmap_index.yaml, implementation_status.md, task records, enrichment JSON, and validation docs.
external_tool_policy: No external tool is installed or executed in T001.
No external source retrieval happens in T001.
External tools are evaluation candidates only.
External tool outputs must become candidate records with evidence/provenance if ever implemented.
External tools must never write prose, rewrite prose, continue prose, or mutate canon/memory.
Removed candidates must stay out of scope unless a later owner-approved parent reintroduces them.

treating marketing claims as validated behavior
writing runtime code based on source review
official_source_retrieval_policy.source_quality_rule: Prefer official docs/repos and primary papers. Use third-party tutorials only as secondary context.
official_source_retrieval_policy.output_rule: Source inventory and evaluation-readiness screen only. Each tool classified as likely runtime adapter candidate, possible runtime adapter candidate, reference-only, or reject/defer with evidence, risk, and implementation prerequisites.
official_source_retrieval_policy.blocked_internet_rule: Stop and ask owner for official source snapshots. Do not substitute memory-based tool claims.
